title: Apache Iggy, a message streaming platform in Rust, graduates to an Apache TLP
summary: Apache Iggy, a high-performance message streaming platform written in Rust, has graduated to become an Apache Top-Level Project (TLP), marking a significant milestone in its maturity and stability as an open-source project under the Apache Software Foundation.
problem_solved: Provides a high-performance, low-latency message streaming solution for real-time data distribution in distributed systems
why_valuable: The Rust implementation delivers excellent performance with memory safety guarantees, and Apache TLP status ensures long-term project stability, corporate-friendly licensing, and robust community governance.
